parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the owner. Valid values:

INSTANCE: an owner of an instance.
DATABASE: an owner of a physical database.
TABLE: an owner of a physical table
parameters.help_zh:
Owner类型，取值如下：
INSTANCE：实例Owner
DATABASE：物理库Owner
TABLE：物理表Owner
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true.: The database is a logical database
false: The database is a physical database
parameters.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值：
true：逻辑库。
false：物理库
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en:
The type of the environment in which the database instance is deployed. Valid values:

product: production environment.
dev: development environment.
pre: pre-release environment.
test: test environment.
sit: system integration testing (SIT) environment.
uat: user acceptance testing (UAT) environment.
pet: stress testing environment.
stag: staging environment
parameters.help_zh:
环境类型，取值如下：
product：生产环境。
dev：开发环境。
pre：预发环境。
test：测试环境。
sit：SIT环境。
uat：UAT环境。
pet：压测环境。
stag：STAG环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the database instance. For more information about the valid values of this parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

resourceList.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

DbId.description_en: The ID of the database in DMS

DbInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the database belongs

DbType.description_en: The database engine type. For more information about the valid values of the DbType parameter, see [DbType parameter]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html）
DbType.description_zh: 数据库类型。返回值请参见[DbType参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html）

EnvType.description_en: The type of the environment to which the database instance belongs

Host.description_en: The endpoint of the instance to which the database belongs
Host.description_zh: 库所属实例的连接地址

Logic.description_en:
Indicates whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database
false: The database is a physical database
Logic.description_zh:
是否逻辑库，取值：
true：逻辑库。
false：物理库

Port.description_en: The connection port of the instance to which the database belongs

SearchName.description_en: The query name of the database

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned. By default, this parameter is not returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认不返回
